thread:
maria: Heads up — proposing to remove the runtime pin for tiny-shim (runtime 2.4.1 -> 2.5.0) in the night window 00:30–01:30 UTC to test the kernel selector fix that should reduce long-seq p95. Need SDK sync + release notes. Any blockers?
sam: rollback plan? how fast can we pin back if things go sideways?
maria: yes — rollback is automated. deploybot will reapply pin to 2.4.1 if error_rate > 3% sustained over 5m or p95 increases > 300ms. I'll paste the checklist in a bit.
deploybot: ACK. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual hold between stages. Automatic rollback triggers: error_rate>0.03 OR p95_delta>300ms. Will post status updates here.
jamie: telemetry FYI — eu-west long-seq p95 has been noisy today. can we do an extra 30m smoke before night run?
maria: infra maintenance prevents a long smoke window. compromise: 30-min canary starting at 00:30 with a manual hold if we see any spike, then decide.
nate: SDK note — SDK v3.1.2 has the tiny-shim client changes (PR #4123). If SDK isn't merged, clients may see a header mismatch. ETA for PR merge is around midnight.
sam: gate the unpin on the SDK merge then. Otherwise we risk protocol mismatch for SDK users.
maria: agreed. gating condition: PR #4123 must be merged by 23:50 UTC or we postpone the unpin to the next window.
deploybot: Tentative schedule set for 00:30 UTC. Gating: "sdk/merge:pr/4123==merged". Will not execute until condition satisfied.
jamie: release notes: include migration snippet for the header rename and a short rollback blurb. Keep it one-liner in the changelog.
maria: will draft release note and rollback checklist in #release-notes. tagging @nate for the SDK snippet.
ops-bot: scheduled monitoring hook created for 00:30–01:30 UTC. Alerts: paging on error_rate>3% or p95_delta>300ms.
maria: update — PR #4123 merged at 23:42 UTC :white_check_mark: gating cleared. Deploybot: proceed at 00:30.
deploybot: Canary started 00:31 UTC -> 10% nodes. Metrics so far: latency down ~8%, errors flat. Advancing to 50%.
sam: HOLD — seeing a 412ms p95 spike in eu-west right after the 50% bump.
maria: hold canary. deploybot: roll back to pinned runtime now.
deploybot: Executing rollback -> applying runtime pin=2.4.1. Command: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=2.4.1 --reason "p95 spike eu-west"`.
deploybot: Rollback complete at 00:44 UTC. Runtime pinned back to 2.4.1. Notifying oncall and opening investigation ticket.
nate: investigating traces — early signal that kernel selector choice mis-scheduled on that GPU topology. Opening issue #873 and will capture logs.
maria: thanks. We'll postpone the unpin to next night window, add an extra 45m smoke/preflight, and include the kernel-selector check in the checklist. I'll update the release notes and postmortem draft. :warning:
sam: +1 on extra smoke. Tag me for the rerun.
jamie: add note to changelog: "unpin attempt aborted — rollback performed; next attempt will include topology check".
maria: done. Closing thread for now — followups in #release-notes and the new issue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
